title: Timestamp theo timezone shop/report
workingTree: dirty; evidence hashes identify the current post-UI003 source files

C01.expected: Reproduce a timestamp/report mismatch on a shop whose timezone differs from Asia/Vientiane and record the API contract boundary before editing.
C01.observed: With shop-demo set to UTC, getCashflow and its label reported UTC while the UI rendered the date range at 07:00 and the 14:00Z snapshot at 21:00. The original helper defaulted to Asia/Vientiane. The first full-page-navigation attempt reset the in-memory MSW store and is retained as a harness finding, not a product result; the accepted baseline uses SPA navigation.

C02.expected: Make display timezone explicit at the shared helper and all affected shop-scoped UI call sites; preserve API instants, date-only values, scope ownership, and canonical contracts.
C02.observed: Removed the helper's implicit Asia/Vientiane default and made timezone required by TypeScript. All 14 affected call sites now pass shop.timezone in bot, imports, finance, integrations, and knowledge. Cashflow/P&L date-only form values still use timezone-aware report boundaries. No OpenAPI, route manifest, token, generated package, or API request contract was changed.

C03.expected: Verify one instant in UTC, Asia/Vientiane, and an offset/DST-capable zone; keep date-only report selections on the selected local calendar day.
C03.observed: The same 2026-09-29T20:30:00Z instant formats as UTC 20:30 29/9/26, Asia/Vientiane 03:30 30/9/26, and America/Los_Angeles 13:30 29/9/26. Focused report/date helper suites passed 15/15, including UTC and Vientiane boundaries and America/New_York DST boundaries.

C04.expected: Verify rendered cashflow From/To/asOf values, date-only request boundaries, a shop timezone change, and cross-browser-timezone behavior in the browser.
C04.observed: The targeted UI003 Chromium case passed 1/1 with the browser timezone pinned to America/Los_Angeles. Shop-demo UTC rendered its UTC From/To/asOf; switching to shop-second rendered Asia/Vientiane values. The same selected date-only range generated UTC boundaries 2026-09-01T00:00Z to 2026-10-01T00:00Z, then Vientiane boundaries 2026-08-31T17:00Z to 2026-09-30T17:00Z. Full rebuilt-demo Chromium E2E passed 156/156, including UI003 at case 54, route-role matrix 357/357, empty states 9/9, and route-error composition 51/51.

C05.expected: Run current source/build gates, record measured limits, update the plan, and leave canonical progress ledgers untouched.
C05.observed: npm run verify passed exit 0: generation 11 outputs/283 schemas/210 operations/54 routes; source check, boundaries 410 imports and 8/8 negative fixtures, lint, typecheck, domain/MSW 88/88, Vitest 72/72, and production build passed. npm run test:e2e passed 156/156 on rebuilt React demo. Demo metrics: initial route 446,979 gzip bytes; largest chunk 185,440 gzip bytes; 1,004-row synthetic customer dataset rendered as one 20-row page in 330ms. Previous raw-chunk advisory remains: 730.75 kB raw / 184.42 kB gzip. FE ledger was read at 2/140 VERIFIED (1.33%) and 28/28 STALE; neither FE ledger nor whole-product plan/progress/tasks were edited.
